name: 陳紅章
objective:
本課程旨在介紹工程統計學的基本理論與應用，內容涵蓋描述統計、機率理論、隨機變數與機率分佈、抽樣分配、參數估計、信賴區間、假設檢定、迴歸分析、可靠度分析及工程數據分析方法。課程將透過數學推導、習題演練及工程案例說明統計方法之原理與應用。此外，學生將使用 Python 進行資料分析、統計模擬與蒙地卡羅模擬，並完成統計分析專題，以培養解決工程問題及數據分析之能力。

This course introduces the fundamental principles and applications of Engineering Statistics. Topics include descriptive statistics, probability theory, random variables and probability distributions, sampling distributions, parameter estimation, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, regression analysis, reliability analysis, and engineering data analytics. Mathematical derivations, problem-solving exercises, and engineering case studies will be used to develop students' understanding of statistical methods. In addition, students will utilize Python for data analysis, statistical simulation, and Monte Carlo methods, culminating in a coding project that applies statistical techniques to real-world engineering problems.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Statistics and Data Visualization
Week 2: Descriptive Statistics and Measures of Variability
Week 3: Probability Concepts and Counting Methods
Week 4: Random Variables and Probability Distributions
Week 5: Discrete Probability Distributions
Week 6: Continuous Probability Distributions
Week 7: Sampling Distributions and Central Limit Theorem
Week 8: Midterm Examination
Week 9: Statistical Estimation and Confidence Intervals
Week 10: Hypothesis Testing Fundamentals
Week 11: Comparison of Means and Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
Week 12: Correlation and Simple Linear Regression
Week 13: Multiple Regression and Model Assessment
Week 14: Statistical Quality Control and Process Capability
Week 15: Reliability Analysis and Engineering Applications
Week 16: Final Examination and Final Project Presentation
Weeks 17–18:  Self Learning (Online Learning, Python Coding Project Development, and Final Report Submission)
scorePolicy:
Weekly assignments: 30%
Midterm exam: 30%
Group project and presentation: 40%
materials: Ross, Sheldon M. Introduction to probability and statistics for engineers and scientists. Academic press, 2020.
